positions.name: KestrelwoodSpectrographCalibrationVerification
positions.frame: how was the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibrated and verified across its observing band?
positions.why: Quill Ashgrove presents the operational baseline for the Kestrelwood spectrograph, pairing the specific frequency calibration (88.4 MHz) with empirical validation against June reference plates across the full observing band.
